description: Every file or folder the mashup reads from either game. Paths are relative to that game's install folder; 'a.cpk|inner/path' names a file inside a CRI archive, and 'a.cpk;b.cpk' searches archives in order. Nothing listed here is ever shipped; it is read from the player's own copy at run time.

rows.purpose: Proves the folder is Persona 4 Golden (the 64-bit Steam release).
rows._notes: Verified from the player's install: Persona 4 Golden/P4G.exe (436 MB, 64-bit) next to data.cpk and steam_api64.dll.

rows.purpose: CRI archives holding P4G's files; English overrides in data_e.cpk are searched first. Portraits are bustup/b<character>_<expression>_<frame>.bin (CRILAYLA-compressed).
rows._notes: Verified from the player's install: data.cpk (8.3 GB, 47,178 files) holds all 1,068 bustups; data_e.cpk holds English overrides.

rows.purpose: English battle voices of the party (Persona summons, 'Persona!' barks) as an ADX2 wave archive.
rows._notes: The archive exists (87.6 MB, AFS2). That it holds the party's battle barks is inferred from its name (btlmem = battle members).

rows.purpose: P4G's music as an ADX2 wave archive (cue names in snd00_bgm.acb next to it).
rows._notes: Verified from the player's install: sound/adx2/bgm/snd00_bgm.awb (298 MB, AFS2) + snd00_bgm.acb.

rows.purpose: The process the Reloaded-II mod loads into.
rows._notes: Catherine.exe (10 MB) is in the player's install, next to steam_api.dll.

rows.purpose: Loose music/sound files; boss track is redirected here.
rows._notes: Verified: Catherine's music is one CRI archive, data/sound/bgm.cpk (+ bgm.csb cue bank); voices in *_voice.cpk; boss sound banks pzl_boss_1..10.csb. A Japanese-voice copy is in data/sound_jp.

rows.purpose: Stage data; which stage file opens tells the mod where Vincent is.
rows._notes: data/puzzle/object holds block models (c001_000.nif ...) per catherine_character_mods.
